recognize_zh: 小圓細胞大小約與旁邊紅血球相當，核幾乎佔滿整個細胞、染色質濃縮成塊，只剩一圈極薄的淡藍色細胞質，即正常的靜止小淋巴球（resting lymphocyte）。
features: Small round cell approximately the size of a red cell
Very high N:C ratio with only a thin rim of cytoplasm
Round nucleus with dense, coarsely clumped chromatin
Scant pale basophilic cytoplasm without granules; normal background red cells
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a small round lymphocyte approximately the size of an adjacent red cell. The nucleus is round with dense, coarsely clumped chromatin and no visible nucleolus, and is surrounded by a thin rim of pale basophilic cytoplasm without granules. Background red cells are normocytic with central pallor. Findings are consistent with a normal resting (small) lymphocyte.

ddx.vs: Normoblasts have a smaller, pyknotic, very dark nucleus and pink-orange hemoglobinized cytoplasm rather than blue cytoplasm.
CLL cells are morphologically similar small lymphocytes with block-like soap-bubble chromatin, recognized by an absolute lymphocytosis with smudge cells and a CD5/CD23+ monoclonal B-cell phenotype.
Small lymphoblasts have finer, more homogeneous chromatin, may show nucleoli and are TdT positive, unlike the coarse clumped chromatin here.
